integrity: Complete proof and standalone exact-integer checker are supplied; independent validation has not been performed. First exact-day historical public source verified is the 2006-01-13 preprint; the 1996 ear-enumeration paper is older but its first public calendar day could not be confirmed.
scientific_limitations: All-order odd-size dyadic nonvanishing and even-size parity valuation stratum only; no full even-size nullity, precise inverse norm, or nonconvex analogue established. Unindexed historical equivalence remains possible.
title: Parity-selective dyadic Fourier rigidity of polygon-triangulation ear profiles
